newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Egypt's prime minister in Singapore to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's prime minister in Singapore to boost trade.

text.p: Egypt's Kamal Ganzouri began the first official visit by an Egyptian prime minister to Singapore on Tuesday to boost trade and other ties.
Ganzouri, accompanied by senior government officials and a business delegation, arrived in the afternoon from Malaysia.
He was met by Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong and was due to meet President Ong Teng Cheong and Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew.
Total trade between the two countries for 1996, including crude oil and petroleum products, amounted to Singapore $332.7 million (US$224.1 million), official Singapore figures show.
Earlier on Tuesday in Malaysia, Ganzouri said Cairo and Kuala Lumpur had agreed on four projects in Egypt involving agriculture, shipyard upgrading, high-technology and oil refining.
Ganzouri will leave Singapore for Beijing on Thursday.
